run_findings.github_contents_aba: LIVE refutation: blob SHA is current-content identity, not history. A -> B -> A restored the original blob SHA and the historical SHA was accepted for a new update.
run_findings.github_ref_exact_cas: Public GraphQL updateRefs has beforeOid/afterOid atomic exact-ref CAS; public REST and the connected update_ref action expose only new sha + force, so the stronger beforeOid precondition is not available through the current Chat connector.
run_findings.mcp_crash_redrive: Stock Tasks still cannot recover CreateTaskAsync-success / Task.Run-not-scheduled. A viable crash-redrive shape needs atomic task+replay-outbox persistence, monotonic attempt claims, stale-result CAS, full ordinary pipeline reconstruction, and effect-side idempotency/fencing; model PASS 12/12.
run_findings.mcp_direct_primitive_risk: Public McpServerTool.InvokeAsync is not a substitute for replaying the full call-tool middleware path; direct primitive redrive can bypass ordinary authorization/policy filters.
run_findings.openhands_existing_action_recovery: Current main equals v1.44.1 pin 9d143aac. Exact source already repairs the unmatched executable ActionEvent stale-HEAD subclass by explicitly parenting recovery AgentErrorEvent to the action and has an integration regression for that path.
run_findings.openhands_remaining_user_message_window: Ordinary user MessageEvent can still fall into event-file-before-deferred-base-save with a stale non-null persisted HEAD and no unmatched-action signal. Saved marker implementation candidate plus exact cross-test candidate for user-message recovery and markerless-orphan non-adoption; not applied/run upstream.
